title: Design a Payment Gateway
summary: Wrap three payment SDKs that disagree about units, method names and how failure is signalled behind one interface, then use an abstract factory so a region's processor, tax rules and money formatting can never be mixed up.
concepts: Adapter for interfaces you do not own and cannot change
Normalising three different failure conventions into one result type
Converting units at the boundary, so a 100x error cannot be made upstream
Abstract Factory for families whose members must stay consistent
Idempotency keys, and why the same key must never charge twice
Distinguishing a decline worth retrying from a request that never will be
extensions: Add a circuit breaker so a provider having an outage is skipped
Handle webhooks for payments that settle asynchronously
Add a reconciliation job for charges whose outcome is unknown
Route by cost, picking the cheapest provider per transaction
Add 3-D Secure, where the flow pauses for the customer to authenticate
Support multi-currency settlement with exchange rates
